title: Bound the nominal sector and obtain compact resolvent
statement: Constant-cycle flux gives <f,Lg>_pi as sum J_Cwu sum_j f(x_j)(g(x_(j+1))-g(x_j)). Subtract the cycle mean of f and apply finite-cycle Poincare/Cauchy-Schwarz to obtain |<f,Lg>|<=2 ell_R sqrt(E_pi(f,f)E_pi(g,g)),ell_R maximum FIXED complex-cycle length. A positive weighted coercivity bound controls form-domain tails outside a population ball, and the finite interior gives compact embedding in L2(pi). The closed nominal sectorial generator consequently has compact resolvent. These are nominal operator conclusions under the proved weighted bound, not uniform small perturbation in the nominal Hilbert space.
